scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/core && npm run build --prefix packages/svg && npm run build --prefix packages/react
scripts.lint: eslint packages src scripts && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/svg/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.validate:packages: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const has = (c) => { try { execSync(c + ' --version', { stdio: 'ignore' }); return true; } catch { return false; } }; const pack = has('pnpm') ? 'pnpm' : has('bun') ? 'bun' : 'false'; for (const p of ['packages/core', 'packages/svg', 'packages/react']) execSync('publint ' + p + ' --pack ' + pack, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
